name: zv-plugins
description: Claude Code Plugin Marketplace - A collection of useful plugins and skills

plugins.name: madr-manager
plugins.description: Interactive MADR (Markdown Architectural Decision Records) manager. Helps create, list, and manage ADR files following the Structured MADR v4.0.0 format.

plugins.name: mktotp-mcp
plugins.description: Interactive TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) manager. Helps create, list, and manage TOTP secrets and generate one-time passwords.

plugins.name: updsts-mcp
plugins.description: Get and update AWS STS credential using existing AWS profile.

plugins.name: exam-exp-gen
plugins.description: Reads exam questions (PDF, images, or text) and generates explanations as markdown, ODT, or DOCX.
